scope: Ten-second timestep check of the unchanged gait with 100% controller authority, declared before the refined run. Numerical agreement, not motor calibration.
invariants: Same selected gait and physical model
Same commands, initial conditions and controller timing
Both runs complete without a fall or solver failure
interpretation: Same absolute numerical budgets as the selected 35% ten-second check: 2 cm travel, 3 cm endpoint position, 0.01 body-up projection and 2 degrees per actuated joint. All bounds must pass. This does not establish hardware accuracy or 300-second performance.
